title: Vegan PDRN Brightening Serum
body_html:
If you've been searching for a vegan PDRN serum that delivers K-beauty-grade results — without salmon DNA, animal derivatives, or synthetic fragrance — this is it. Our Vegan PDRN Brightening Serum pairs non-animal-sourced polydeoxyribonucleotide with Argireline peptide and layered hydration actives for a brighter, firmer-looking complexion. Clean ingredients, honest sourcing, clinical performance.

Key Ingredients

  • Polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) — non-salmon-derived: Most commercial PDRN is extracted from salmon sperm. Ours is not. This non-animal-sourced PDRN supports fibroblast activity and promotes a more luminous, resilient-looking barrier.
  • Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 (Argireline): A signaling peptide that helps relax the appearance of fine lines over time — no irritation, no photosensitivity, no retinol needed.
  • Sodium Hyaluronate: A low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid that draws deep moisture into the skin's surface layers for an immediate plumped, dewy look.
  • Panthenol (Vitamin B5): Calms, softens, and supports the moisture barrier — especially helpful for stress-reactive or sensitized skin.
  • Glycerin & Sodium PCA: Dependable humectants that pull water to the surface and lock it in, giving the formula its silky, comfortable finish.

What It Does

  • Brightens uneven tone — PDRN and Argireline peptide reduce the look of dullness and discoloration.
  • Softens fine lines — Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 visibly relaxes expression lines within 4–6 weeks of twice-daily use.
  • Deep, lasting hydration — Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, and Sodium PCA keep skin plump well past application.
  • Barrier support — Panthenol and Propanediol condition and reinforce the skin's protective layer.
  • Lightweight, non-greasy — Absorbs quickly and layers well under SPF or moisturizer.

How to Use

  1. Apply 2–4 pumps to clean, dry skin.
  2. Gently massage over face and neck until fully absorbed.
  3. Use twice daily — morning and evening.
  4. Follow with moisturizer or SPF as your final step.

Who It's For

Made for moms who read ingredient labels and refuse to settle. If you want the brightening power of a clinical K-beauty serum — without salmon-derived actives, animal products, or hidden synthetic fragrance — this was formulated for you. Ideal for skin that's stressed, hormonally reactive, or craving a clean-ingredient glow.

Free From

No salmon DNA • No animal derivatives • No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No retinol • No phthalates

Clean PDRN Meets K-Beauty Science

PDRN — polydeoxyribonucleotide — originated in Korean dermatology clinics as an injectable treatment for skin repair and regeneration before moving into topical K-beauty formulations. The catch: virtually all commercially available PDRN is derived from salmon sperm DNA.

Our PDRN is non-animal-sourced, giving health-conscious moms access to the same K-beauty-grade active without the animal origin — a rare positioning in the clean beauty space. Paired with Argireline peptide and a USA-made formula, this serum respects both your values and your skin.

Size & Specs

1 fl oz / 30 ml. At twice-daily use, a bottle typically lasts 6–8 weeks. Pump dispenser for hygienic, measured application. Manufactured in the USA.

Full Ingredient List

Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Propanediol, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium PCA, Polydeoxyribonucleotide, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Hydroxide

Suggested Use: Apply 2–4 pumps to clean, dry skin. Massage over face and neck until absorbed. Use twice daily. Follow with moisturizer or sunscreen.

Warning: For external use only. Avoid eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use on broken skin. Store in a cool, dry place.

faq_json.question: Is this PDRN vegan?
faq_json.answer: Yes — our PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is non-animal-sourced. Most PDRN on the market, including in popular K-beauty serums, is derived from salmon sperm DNA. Ours is not. The entire formula contains no animal derivatives of any kind, making it suitable for vegan skincare routines.

faq_json.question: Does this contain salmon DNA?
faq_json.answer: No. This is one of the key things that sets our serum apart. The vast majority of commercial PDRN products — including clinical injectables and popular K-beauty serums — use salmon-derived polydeoxyribonucleotide. Our PDRN is non-salmon-derived and contains no fish or animal DNA whatsoever.

faq_json.question: What does PDRN do for skin?
faq_json.answer: PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a bioactive molecule that supports fibroblast activity — the cells responsible for collagen production and skin repair. Applied topically, it helps strengthen the skin barrier, reduce the appearance of dullness and uneven tone, and promote a plumper, more resilient-looking complexion. It originated in Korean dermatology as an injectable treatment and has since become a K-beauty hero ingredient.

faq_json.question: Can I use this during pregnancy or while breastfeeding?
faq_json.answer: We always recommend consulting your healthcare provider or OB before adding any new skincare active during pregnancy or breastfeeding. That said, this formula does not contain retinoids, retinol, salicylic acid, or hydroquinone — the ingredients most commonly flagged during pregnancy. The formula does contain phenoxyethanol (see below) and Acetyl Hexapeptide-8; your provider can help you assess these for your individual situation.

faq_json.question: How does PDRN compare to retinol?
faq_json.answer: Both PDRN and retinol support skin renewal and can improve the look of brightness and fine lines, but they work differently. Retinol accelerates cell turnover and can cause peeling, redness, and photosensitivity — especially in the early weeks. PDRN works more gently, supporting the skin's own repair signaling without the irritation or sun sensitivity. For those who can't tolerate retinol or prefer to avoid it during pregnancy, PDRN is a compelling alternative.

faq_json.question: Does this contain phenoxyethanol?
faq_json.answer: Yes, it does — and we'd rather tell you directly than hope you don't notice. Phenoxyethanol is used in this formula as a preservative to prevent bacterial and mold growth, which is essential for any water-based product. It's one of the most effective non-paraben preservative options available at low concentrations. Our use level falls within EWG-acceptable ranges (typically rated 1–2). We know some crunchy-mom shoppers prefer to avoid it; that's a fair call, and we respect it. We won't pretend it isn't there.

faq_json.question: How long until I see results?
faq_json.answer: Hydration and skin smoothness improvements are often noticeable within the first few applications. For brightening, tone evening, and visible softening of fine lines, most users see meaningful change at the 4–6 week mark with consistent twice-daily use. PDRN and peptide results are cumulative — the longer you use it, the more your skin banks the benefits.
